name: GetMyInvoices
description: Automatically fetch, organize and manage incoming invoices, receipts and documents from thousands of portals, mailboxes and scans in GetMyInvoices.
instructions:
GetMyInvoices is a German SaaS platform (developed by fino data services) that automatically retrieves and centralizes incoming invoices, receipts and statements from thousands of online portals, email inboxes and scans. The REST API v3 is documented at https://api.getmyinvoices.com/accounts/v3/doc/.

## Authentication
Generate an API key in GetMyInvoices under Settings → API / Integrations. Set it as `GETMYINVOICES_API_KEY`. The connector sends it in the `ApiKey` header.

## Core concepts
- **Documents** (`/documents`) — invoices, receipts and credit notes fetched from portals or uploaded. Identified by numeric `id`. Records include invoice number, date, due date, net/gross amounts, currency, VAT details, line items, payment status and assigned company/vendor.
- **Companies** (`/companies`) — suppliers, portals and vendors associated with retrieved invoices.

## Pagination
List endpoints use offset-based pagination: `offset` (0-based, default 0) and `limit` (default 50, max 100).

## Dates & filters
Filter documents by date range using `startDate` and `endDate` (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Filter by document direction/kind using `type` (`INCOMING`, `OUTGOING`), by workflow state using `status` (e.g. `NEW`, `ACCEPTED`, `ARCHIVED`), or by specific vendor using `companyId`.

## Tips
- Use `getmyinvoices_list_documents` with `type=INCOMING` to search for incoming portal invoices.
- Fetch full metadata, amounts and line items using `getmyinvoices_get_document`.
- Fetch the original invoice file (PDF/scan) using `getmyinvoices_get_document_file`.

tools.name: getmyinvoices_list_documents
tools.description: List documents (invoices, receipts) from GetMyInvoices with optional filtering by date range, status, type and company. Returns document numbers, dates, amounts, status and metadata.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination, 0-based (default 0)

limit.description: Number of records to return (default 50, max 100)

startDate.description: Filter documents on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: Filter documents on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

type.description: Filter by document type, e.g. INCOMING or OUTGOING

status.description: Filter by document status, e.g. NEW, ACCEPTED, ARCHIVED

tools.name: getmyinvoices_get_document
tools.description: Get complete metadata for a single GetMyInvoices document by numeric ID, including line items, VAT rates, totals, company info and payment status.

tools.name: getmyinvoices_get_document_file
tools.description: Fetch the original document file (PDF or scan) from GetMyInvoices by document ID.

tools.name: getmyinvoices_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (suppliers, portals and vendors) stored in GetMyInvoices with pagination.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination, 0-based (default 0)

limit.description: Number of records to return (default 50, max 100)

tools.name: getmyinvoices_get_company
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single company (supplier/vendor) by ID from GetMyInvoices.
